stolen.line: I've got drama, can't be stolen
stanza: Look up here, I'm in heaven
I've got scars that can't be seen
I've got drama, can't be stolen

stolen.songTitle: Stuck Inside of Mobile with the Memphis Blues Again
stolen.line: But the post office has been stolen
stanza: Well, Shakespeare, he's in the alley
With his pointed shoes and his bells
Who says she knows me well
And I would send a message
To find out if she's talked
But the post office has been stolen
